appearances.title: Weather downscaling model trained in 1 GPU-hour sharpens forecasts over France from 28 km to 5.5 km
appearances.summary: Instead of a bigger global model, a small model on top learns how terrain and coasts shape local weather, trained in one hour on one GPU. The authors say it gets closer to weather-station readings, especially in mountains; a blog post and a demo Space are public.
